ACT VIII OF 2011
TRANSFER OF PROPERTY (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2011
An Act further to amend the Transfer of
Property Act, 1882
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary,
2nd May, 2011
No.PAP-Legis-2(61)/2011/386, dated 2-5-2011.---The Transfer of Property
(Amendment) Bill 2011, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on 30 March 2011, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 30
April 2011, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab.
Preamble.- Whereas
it is expedient further to amend the Transfer of Property Act, 1882 (IV of
1882), for purposes hereinafter appearing;
(2) It is enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.- (1) This Act may be cited as the Transfer of Property
(Amendment) Act 2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Preamble.- Whereas

1882), for purposes hereinafter appearing;
(2) It is enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment in section 1 of Act IV of 1882.- In the Transfer of Property Act, 1882 (IV of 1882),
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, for section 1, the following shall be
substituted:-
"1. Short
title, commencement, extent and exemption.- (1) This
Act may be cited as the Transfer of Property Act, 1882.
(2) It shall come into force on the first
day of July, 1882.
(3) The Government may, by notification
in the official Gazette, extend the Act to the whole or any part of the Punjab.
(4) The Government may, by notification
in the official Gazette, exempt either retrospectively or prospectively, any
part of the Punjab from all or any of
paragraphs 2 and 3 of section 54, section 59, section 107 and section 123.
(5) Notwithstanding anything in this
section, paragraphs 2 and 3 of section 54, section 59, section 107 and section
123 shall not extend or be extended to any district for the time being excluded
from the operation of the Registration Act, 1908 (XVI of 1908)."
